description.value: Kisamos Greek Taverna has been serving traditional, scratch-made Greek cuisine in the heart of historic Steveston Village for over 20 years. Named after a town on the island of Crete, the restaurant is known for generous portions, fresh daily-prepared dishes including roast lamb and seafood, and a casual family-friendly atmosphere. Steveston Village is a popular cycling destination on the Lower Mainland's extensive bike network, making this a naturally convenient dining stop for touring cyclists.
